	// Cache jQuery selectors for better performance

		$("#pageLoader").fadeOut(200);

        if (typeof userIdentify !== 'undefined') {
          userIdentify.then(function () {

              $subscriptionCard

              $subscriptionCard

                .addClass("no-subscription");
            }
          });
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.log('Error checking subscription status:', error);
      }
    }
  }

    if (typeof tp !== 'undefined' && tp.pianoId && tp.user && tp.user.isUserValid()) {

        var userDetails = tp.pianoId.getUser();

        $userEmailDisplay.text('User logged in');
      }
    }

  // ACCOUNT CLICK (logged out view + open comments)

require(['jquery'], function($) {	
	$(function () {
	 const $window = $(window);
    const $header = $(".header");
    const $headerOuter = $(".header-outer");
    const $floatingAd = $(".flooting-ad");
    const $pagination = $(".nav-pagination");

    let prevScroll = window.pageYOffset;

    function handleScroll() {

        let currentScroll = window.pageYOffset;
        let scrollTop = $window.scrollTop();
        let windowWidth = $window.width();

        let headerOuterTop = $headerOuter.offset().top;
        let headerOuterBottom = headerOuterTop + $headerOuter.outerHeight();

        const isArticleMenu = $header.hasClass("article-menu");
        const isMobile = windowWidth < 571;

        // ✅ Reset point logic
        let resetPoint;

        if (isMobile) {
            // Mobile → same for both
            resetPoint = headerOuterTop;
        } else {
            // Desktop → different behavior
            resetPoint = isArticleMenu
                ? headerOuterTop
                : headerOuterBottom;
        }

        // ✅ Before reset point → reset state
        if (scrollTop <= resetPoint) {

            if (isArticleMenu) {
                $header.removeClass("header-move"); // keep on-scroll
            } else {
                $header.removeClass("on-scroll header-move");
            }

            $header.css("transform", "translateY(0)");

            prevScroll = currentScroll;
            return;
        }

        // ✅ Start animation only AFTER header-outer ends
        if (scrollTop <= headerOuterBottom) {
            prevScroll = currentScroll;
            return;
        }

        // ✅ Smart header animation
        if (prevScroll > currentScroll) {

            // 🔼 Scroll UP
            $header.addClass("on-scroll header-move")
                   .css("transform", "translateY(0)");

            if (windowWidth < 600) {
                $floatingAd.stop(true, true).slideUp();
            }

            if ($pagination.length) {
                if (windowWidth > 1040) {
                    $pagination.css("top", "75px");
                } else if (windowWidth < 571) {
                    $pagination.css("top", "65px");
                } else {
                    $pagination.css("top", "49px");
                }
            }

        } else {

            // 🔽 Scroll DOWN
            let hideValue = windowWidth > 1040 ? "-250px" : "-100px";

            $header.css("transform", `translateY(${hideValue})`);

            if (windowWidth < 600) {
                $floatingAd.stop(true, true).slideDown();
            }

            if ($pagination.length) {
                $pagination.css("top", "0px");
            }
        }

        prevScroll = currentScroll;
    }

    handleScroll();
    $window.on("scroll", handleScroll);
	});
 });

  list-style: none;
  margin: 30px auto;
  padding: 0;
  overflow-x: auto;
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-align: center;
}
.stories-list .storie-item {
  display: inline-block;
  vertical-align: top;
  width: 18%;
  border-radius: 8px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.stories-list .storie-item .picture {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: unset;
  position: relative;
  --bs-aspect-ratio: calc(6 / 4 * 100%);
}
.stories-list .storie-item .picture::before {
  display: block;
  padding-top: var(--bs-aspect-ratio);
  content: "";
}
.stories-list .storie-item .picture > * {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}
.stories-list .storie-item .picture img {
  width: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: center;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: unset;
}
.stories-list .storie-item .picture .text-part {
  background: linear-gradient(
    0deg,
    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8),
    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6),
    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4),
    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0),
    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.21),
    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.66)
  );
  position: absolute;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
}
.stories-list .storie-item .picture .text-part .past-stories {
  display: flex;
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 8px;
  left: 6px;
  right: 6px;
  z-index: 1;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.stories-list .storie-item .picture .text-part .past-stories span {
  height: 2px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background-color: #fff;
  opacity: 0.4;
  margin-right: 3px;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-top: 5px;
  margin-left: 3px;
  flex: 1;
}
.stories-list .storie-item .picture .text-part .past-stories span.active {
  opacity: 1;
}
.stories-list .storie-item .picture .icon-part {
  height: 30px;
  width: 30px;
  margin: 14px;
}
.stories-list .storie-item .picture .icon-part img {
  height: 30px;
  width: 30px;
}
.stories-list .storie-item .title {
  color: #000000;
  font-family: "Merriweather", serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.2px;
  font-size: 14px;
  text-align: left;
  padding: 15px 3px 0;
  position: relative;
  bottom: 10px;
  line-height: normal;
  white-space: normal;
}
.stories-list.inner-page {
  overflow-x: unset;
  white-space: unset;
  margin: unset;
  padding: unset;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 0px 10px 10px 10px;
}
.stories-list.inner-page .storie-item {
  margin: 0px 8px 10px 8px;
  width: 100%;
}

.box-line-title .shorts {
  font-size: 30px;
  top: 0px;
}

/** Mobile Responsive Styles **/
@media screen and (max-width: 570px) {
  .stories-list {
    margin: 20px auto 10px;
    padding-bottom: 10px;
  }
  .stories-list .storie-item {
    width: 150px;
    margin: 0 3px;
    border-radius: 3px;
    vertical-align: top;
  }
  .stories-list .storie-item .text-part .title {
    font-size: 9px;
    text-align: left;
    padding: 5px 5px 0;
    bottom: 5px;
  }
  .stories-list .storie-item .picture .past-stories span {
    width: 5.6px;
    margin-right: 0px;
  }
  .stories-list .storie-item .picture .icon-part {
    height: 20px;
    width: 20px;
    margin: 0px 5px;
  }
  .stories-list .storie-item .picture .icon-part img {
    height: 20px;
    width: 20px;
  }
  .stories-list.inner-page .storie-item {
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0;
  }
}

    display: none;
}

.stories-list {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 30px auto;
  padding: 0;
  overflow-x: auto;
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-align: center;
}
.stories-list .storie-item {
  display: inline-block;
  vertical-align: top;
  width: 18%;
  border-radius: 8px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.stories-list .storie-item .picture {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: unset;
  position: relative;
  --bs-aspect-ratio: calc(6 / 4 * 100%);
}
.stories-list .storie-item .picture::before {
  display: block;
  padding-top: var(--bs-aspect-ratio);
  content: "";
}
.stories-list .storie-item .picture > * {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}
.stories-list .storie-item .picture img {
  width: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: center;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: unset;
}
.stories-list .storie-item .picture .text-part {
  background: linear-gradient(
    0deg,
    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8),
    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6),
    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4),
    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0),
    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.21),
    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.66)
  );
  position: absolute;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
}
.stories-list .storie-item .picture .text-part .past-stories {
  display: flex;
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 8px;
  left: 6px;
  right: 6px;
  z-index: 1;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.stories-list .storie-item .picture .text-part .past-stories span {
  height: 2px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background-color: #fff;
  opacity: 0.4;
  margin-right: 3px;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-top: 5px;
  margin-left: 3px;
  flex: 1;
}
.stories-list .storie-item .picture .text-part .past-stories span.active {
  opacity: 1;
}
.stories-list .storie-item .picture .icon-part {
  height: 30px;
  width: 30px;
  margin: 14px;
}
.stories-list .storie-item .picture .icon-part img {
  height: 30px;
  width: 30px;
}
.stories-list .storie-item .title {
  color: #000000;
  font-family: "Merriweather", serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.2px;
  font-size: 14px;
  text-align: left;
  padding: 15px 3px 0;
  position: relative;
  bottom: 10px;
  line-height: normal;
  white-space: normal;
}
.stories-list.inner-page {
  overflow-x: unset;
  white-space: unset;
  margin: unset;
  padding: unset;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 0px 10px 10px 10px;
}
.stories-list.inner-page .storie-item {
  margin: 0px 8px 10px 8px;
  width: 100%;
}

    function parseJwt (token) {
        var base64Url = token.split('.')[1];
        var base64 = base64Url.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
        var jsonPayload = decodeURIComponent(window.atob(base64).split('').map(function(c) {
            return '%' + ('00' + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16)).slice(-2);
        }).join(''));

        return JSON.parse(jsonPayload);
